messages:
Maya: Quick sync — we need a sharp benchmark narrative for next week's launch. primary ask: hero chart + 2 variants that tell the latency vs cost story for hosted vs dedicated. can someone take the lead? :eyes:
Sam: I can help with audience split. do we want one chart that targets SMB (cost-sensitive) and one for enterprise (latency-sensitive)?
Devon: yes, exactly. two lanes: 'unit econ' for cost per 1k tokens and 'latency SLOs' for p50/p95. also want a combined scatter for product marketing — show cost on x, median latency on y, points = model + deployment (hosted/dedicated).
Leo: can do. need the sample dataset (token counts, cost assumptions, p50/p95). also what axis scales do you want? linear vs log for cost?
Anya: design constraints: keep palette consistent with brand (deep teal / amber accents), avoid heavy gridlines, annotate the hero point (our recommended config). will add figma frames for hero + social crop. link: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/benchmark-assets
Maya: priority: hero chart (social + slide) by EOD today; variant A = scatter (cost vs median latency), variant B = stacked area showing cumulative cost by token length for different quantization configs.
Sam: inbound routing note — make sure the hero image has 2 CTAs baked in: "Run your model" (self-serve) and "Book Dedicated" (sales). we'll A/B test which CTA drives better MQLs.
Devon: suggested copy options to test:
- Option 1: "Same accuracy. 3x cheaper. Predictable latency."
- Option 2: "Latency SLAs at scale — save on token cost without tradeoffs."
Pick one for webinar hero, the other for sticky social caption.
Leo: uploading quick mock CSV to the shared drive now. also throwing up two filenames for assets:
```
hero_scatter_latency_cost_v1.png
hero_area_cost_by_tokens_v1.png
```
Maya: perfect. @Leo can you include an overlay annotation for "typical LLM app slice" (50–300 tokens) and a dotted line for our p95 target?
Leo: yep. will annotate and include a tiny legend. also will export a square social crop and a 16:9 slide version.
Anya: for accessibility — use >=4.5:1 contrast for primary text. will create alt-text drafts for both charts.
Sam: routing: when people click "Run your model" link, route them to the benchmark sandbox with pre-filled prompt. if they click "Book Dedicated" open the enterprise contact form with checkbox "benchmark discussed". tagging @sales for follow-up.
Devon: webinar plan — 10 min demo, 8 min Q&A, use hero scatter as opening slide. want a short 3-bullet narrative: 1) predictable latency matters, 2) cost per token is controllable via batching/quantization, 3) Redwood gives simple routing to balance both.
Maya: timeline recap — EOD: Leo + Anya deliver assets; EOW: draft landing page and social copy; next Tue: webinar dry run.
bench-bot: benchmark run finished (174 trials) — summary: hosted median latency 120ms, dedicated median 35ms; average cost delta 2.9x. full report: https://internal.redwood/bench/3077777777
Sam: awesome stats. Leo — can you surface the p95 numbers prominently? that's what enterprise cares about.
Leo: will highlight p95 and add callouts for dedicated configs. final assets coming in ~4 hours. :rocket:
